scope: Static diagnosis of the retained 2026-10-04 Paper 1.21.1 setup failure; not a graphical vanilla-client reproduction or general large-teleport conformance claim
method: Read-only javap inspection of the exact extracted official Paper jars; no decompiled implementation copied into the repository

observed_failure.client_response: Probe rejected the additional correction and stopped before gameplay

paper_1_21_1_findings: ServerGamePacketListenerImpl.tick calls resetPosition; resetPosition writes firstGoodXYZ.
internalTeleport changes player position and sets awaitingPositionFromClient without updating firstGoodXYZ.
handleAcceptTeleportPacket updates lastGoodXYZ and clears awaitingPositionFromClient, but firstGoodXYZ remains until the next listener tick.
handleMovePlayer ignores position movement while awaitingPositionFromClient is non-null; after acceptance it validates against firstGoodXYZ.

The logged delta matches the previous random spawn baseline, consistent with an accepted ACK followed by the normal immediate position reply in the same server tick, rather than position overtaking ACK.

spawn_source_findings: Older ServerPlayer.adjustSpawnLocation reads the ordinary radius through MinecraftServer.getSpawnRadius and GameRules.RULE_SPAWN_RADIUS.
Modern ServerPlayer.adjustSpawnLocation delegates to PlayerSpawnFinder.findSpawn, which reads GameRules.RESPAWN_RADIUS; the identifier is respawn_radius, not spawn_radius.
The randomized candidate count is derived from (2r+1)^2; zero leaves one candidate.
Modern GameRuleCommand registers both the namespaced and short rule identifiers.
